name: Application Scoring

model.region: Global endpoint of the provider, outside Qatar
model.trainingUse: Free tier of the provider's API: prompts and answers may be used by the provider to improve its products.

subProcessors.purpose: Hosting of the service and its daily schedule

data.purpose: Score each application and explain the score
